QuestInfo.name: The Dark Lord's Request
QuestInfo.0: JM in Kerning City has a request for you.
QuestInfo.1: #bThe #p1052001##k is helping Kerning City repair its old buildings, and hired #b#p1052103##k to get adventurers to help out. #bJM#k can make the bricks, but he needs #b#t4000623#s#k from the nearby #bSwamp Region#k. Gather #b80 #t4000623#s#k and take them to #bJM#k.
QuestInfo.2: You delivered the Mud Clumps to JM.

0.0: I have another job for you. You're up for it, aren't you?

yes.0: Okay. #b#p1052001##k is at work on a project to replace the worn out bricks in Kerning City. Many #b#t04032802#s#k are required for the project, but they're so hard to obtain.
yes.1: I need to craft #b10 #t04032802#s#k. I know how to make bricks, but I can't make them out of thin air, you know. #b80 #t4000623#s#k should be enough. Eliminate Muddy Swamp Monsters and bring me loads of Mud Clumps.

no.0: Are you sure you don't care? The reward is quite significant. Well, come see me again if you change your mind.

1.1: Yeah, this's enough. Just give me a minute to make the #t4032802#s...

item.0: We need more Mud Clumps than this. It'll take at least 80 to make 10 bricks.

mob.0: Don't forget to eliminate 150 Muddy Swamp Monsters! Don't need them coming back for their clumps.
